>

> Let the path be QRP, where RM = $x$ is the variable

>

> The time taken (T) to traverse QRP is a function of $x$

>

> $$T = \frac{D - x}{v} + \frac{2\sqrt{d^{2} + x^{2}}}{v}$$

>

> For time to be minimum $\frac{dT}{dx} = 0$
